review.identity: Canonical neutral supplied directly to every generation; original species-specific face, eye form, palette, markings and watercolor contour retained. Tiger stripes, Siamese blue eyes/brown points, hedgehog spines all visually compared.
review.style: Full-resolution light/dark composites inspected. Original watercolor texture stays inside silhouettes; no outside paper field or visible haze. No pixel repainting, alpha cleaning or contour repair.
review.alpha: All18 original RGBA cells nonempty, alpha maximum255, full alpha8 silhouettes have >=2px clearance on every cell edge. Raw low-alpha RGB/edge noise preserved and inspected through correct compositing.
review.motion: Four eye-catches have explicit tea lift/sip/lower, polite half/deep bow/return, jump preparation/takeoff/air/landing and opposing dance/step/finish keys. Cup rim meets mouth in sip key and tea is amber. Bow range is a deliberately gentle stylized inclination. Jump feet are visibly airborne and use inferred ground support. Discrete key poses require scene timing/interpolation review.

calibration.method: Measured first-sheet neutral standing proxy and neutral-head-envelope width transfer across sheets; fixed per-sheet isotropic scale.
calibration.notes: All nine cells of each sheet share this one reference height. No per-pose bounding-box fitting or rescaling. Numeric spans are art-registration proxies, not measured skeleton pivots. Bowed/crouched/airborne silhouettes keep their drawn differences.
